desc: Cardboard knight: living armor of stacked cardboard boxes with tape-strip cape and gold tape trim, a black void helmet with a thin glowing slit eye, holding a light bulb lance. Living Backrooms creature, cute chibi but cool, right-facing 3/4. 16-bit pixel art, 1px navy outline, 2-3 flat shades, no gradients, no noise, no glow, no shadow. Yellow wallpaper, cardboard brown, lavender, gold palette.
